title: Kamailio World 2016 – Videos : Hours Of Knowledge About Kamailio And Other Projects
html:
Kamailio world is our annual conference in Berlin, hosted in Fraunhofer Focus – where it all started 15 years ago. The videos for the 2016 conference are now published in our youtube channel.

Here’s one of the sessions – the Dangerous Demos by TruPhone. There are many to pick from, from the tutorials to the case studies and the panel discussions.

Enjoy and see you in Berlin next year!
